curated.conceptDesc: Zero-waste assembly workflow where supplier parts roll off delivery trucks directly into assembly bays on exact kanban triggers.
curated.oneLiner: An inventory strategy where parts arrive on the factory floor minutes before assembly — eliminating warehouse storage waste.
curated.notes: Eliminates holding costs for military supply fulfillment.

anatomy.desc: Parts delivered precisely when the line is ready for assembly.
Direct transit from delivery truck straight to the assembly station.
Eliminating dusty warehouse holding costs and tied-up cash.

flow.title: Kanban Signal
flow.desc: Assembly line consumes part bin and triggers digital signal.

flow.title: Supplier Truck Departs
flow.desc: Supplier loads exact bin quantities and departs dock.

flow.title: Dock Cross-Docking
flow.desc: Bin moves straight onto production floor with zero storage.

flow.title: Finished Car Ships
flow.desc: Completed vehicle rolls off line and ships to customer.

replaces: Capital tied up in unsold inventory
